contexts.text: The learned confirm falsities by syllogistic and philosophical things.
Philosophical things... have consisted solely in terms, and the syllogism...
It is the same with syllogistic philosophy, which so confines the ideas of men's minds that there is scarcely any opening for the light.
How worthless syllogistic philosophy is... By a thousand syllogisms formed by those devoid of understanding, this Truth itself seems as if it might be destroyed...
The conclusion (in logic) is frequently such that it is intelligible without any syllogism.
